message.content: The Leshy Pebble Spring arrived in the city. They loved the paved ground. They admired the intricate bridges. They loved houses most of all. Stone walls formed shelters. Those shelters connected earth to family stories. The weather stayed outside the walls. Pebble Spring decided to learn housebuilding. They made a staff. The staff held arcane magic. A little magic helped them understand. They studied beams. They studied doors. They studied roofs. They studied windows. They studied floors. They studied foundations. They studied chimneys. They studied porches. They studied gardens. They studied paths. They studied lamps. They studied every part of a home. Although Pebble Spring learned much about city life, bridges, walls, stories, magic, homes, weather, stone, wood, glass, iron, water, light, warmth, shelter, safety, comfort, and craft, their careful building work was often a little spotty.
